scripts.postbuild: node scripts/prune-routes.mjs && node scripts/generate-redirects.mjs out/_redirects && node scripts/generate-headers.mjs
scripts.deploy:prod: node scripts/clear-build-cache.mjs && pnpm build && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/clear-build-cache.mjs && pnpm build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:eu:prod: node scripts/clear-build-cache.mjs && node scripts/build-site.mjs --site eu && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.eu.jsonc
scripts.deploy:eu:staging: node scripts/clear-build-cache.mjs && node scripts/build-site.mjs --site eu --env staging && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.eu.jsonc --env staging
